# HelloWorldKotlinApp

Native Android application engineered by **Universal AI Builder Platform**.

- **Package Name:** `com.universalaibuilder.helloworld`
- **Language:** Kotlin 1.9.22
- **Android SDK:** Compile SDK 34, Min SDK 24
- **Prompt:** "Native Kotlin Android app with a white background and centered black Hello World! text"
- **Background Color:** `#FFFFFF`
- **Text Color:** `#000000`
- **Display Text:** "Hello World!"

## Build Instructions
```bash
# Assemble Release APK
./gradlew assembleRelease

# Assemble Release AAB (Android App Bundle)
./gradlew bundleRelease
```
